target_customer: Developers building web3 applications who need wallet login and access control
problem: Web3 apps lacked login, role based access control and data storage tooling comparable to Web2 auth services.
business_model: Developer platform, likely usage or seat pricing (not found)
product_category: Web3 authentication and access control platform

founders.name: Ned Rockson
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page; no background given there.

founders.name: Nicolas Salhuana
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page; no background given there.

technical_complexity.rationale: Wallet signature auth, role based access control and storage across chains is standard engineering with some web3 specific hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Auth SDKs can lock in developers once integrated, but open standards such as Sign-In with Ethereum made copying easy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Moralis later offered wallet authentication, but its 2021 and 2022 docs are undated here and no direct action against SlashAuth was found.

market_need_then: Web3 developer tooling demand was rising in 2021, but no SlashAuth customer or revenue evidence was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand was found, and the name collides with unrelated Slash products and a Slashtags npm package.

outcome_analysis: SlashAuth was a three person web3 developer platform from San Francisco in YC Winter 2021, offering login, access control and storage. YC lists it as inactive, but no shutdown notice, acquirer, funding record or cause is public, so the cause is not known. A failure database claims 2023 and low traction, but it is a weak source and is not used for factors.
notes: No website is listed on the YC page; only a Twitter link, so the site could not be fetched (treated as dead or unlisted). Moralis and Alchemy listings name the same two founders. No funding found beyond the standard YC deal. loot-drop.io claims a 2023 failure and 2022 founding, which conflicts with YC (2020) and is excluded. Dated competitor sources near 2021 were not found.
